create_quantized_model: create a LlamaForCausalLM model with 8-bit quantization and auto device mapping for memory-efficient inference
create_tokenizer: create a LlamaTokenizer from a pretrained model name for text tokenization
run_generate_text: run model.generate with 8-bit quantized model to produce text output from a prompt
decode_generated_tokens: decode generated token ids from the model using the tokenizer with special tokens skipped
configure_cuda_memory: configure CUDA device memory limits for multi-gpu 8-bit model loading
